sources.quote:
Context caching price Not available $0.025 (text / image / video)
$0.05 (audio)
$1.00 / 1,000,000 tokens per hour (storage price)
sources.supports: Google's fetched pricing page lists context caching at $0.025 for text/image/video and a separate storage price of $1.00 per million tokens per hour. It does not establish when this pricing applied in the earlier period or how models.dev mapped the storage charge.

notes: The current Google pricing page shows a separate hourly storage charge alongside context caching, but does not establish the official price in the earlier period or whether models.dev's cache_write field represented that charge. The Internet Archive CDX endpoint was unavailable (HTTP 503), so no archived before/after snapshots could be checked; the classification and effective date remain unclear.
